name: Café Cat by yomowasa
recipeDetail:
Comments from the Creator
When creating this soft, sepia-film-like recipe, I imagined a cat enveloped in the steam from a cup of coffee. Mid-tones are an orangish yellow that brings out the natural warmth in wood and fur. Highlights are layered with a reddish orange, and shadows also include warm colors. This prevents dark areas from appearing too dark, while preserving the beauty of the cat’s white fur. Edges are slightly enhanced to preserve details without sacrificing softness. Chroma is reduced overall to create a balanced look—softening the background while retaining warmth in the red-to-orange tones. Slightly reducing exposure enhances the nostalgic look, while increasing it creates a soft, café-like ambiance. I recommend this recipe for capturing a cat's quiet moments under soft indoor lighting.
